title: Unify profile view/edit into single /profile page flow

requirements.summary: Remove the modal-based edit flow from ProfileMenu and route all profile actions through /profile.
acceptanceCriteria: The ProfileMenu dropdown no longer shows separate "View Profile" and "Edit Profile" actions that lead to different experiences (page vs modal).
Clicking the profile menu entry navigates to /profile and does not open an edit dialog modal.
No profile editing dialog (Dialog) is rendered from ProfileMenu after this change.

file_operations.description: Remove local edit-dialog state and the Dialog UI; replace the separate view/edit handlers with navigation-only actions to the unified /profile page (including an edit-mode navigation option via URL query, e.g., navigate to /profile?edit=1).

requirements.summary: Make /profile support in-page view and edit modes, with optional initialization into edit mode via a URL indicator (e.g., ?edit=1).
acceptanceCriteria: /profile continues to show a read-only view mode and an in-page edit mode (no separate edit screen/modal required).
When /profile is opened with an explicit edit indicator (for example, ?edit=1), the page initializes in edit mode.
When /profile is opened without the edit indicator, the page initializes in view mode (current behavior).
After saving or cancelling edits on /profile, the user returns to view mode on the same page and profile data is updated/reflected correctly.

file_operations.description: Read an edit indicator from the URL (e.g., using existing utilities in frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts and/or TanStack Router navigation/search) and initialize isEditing accordingly; ensure save/cancel transitions back to view mode and clears the edit indicator from the URL to avoid re-entering edit mode on refresh.

Add a small, non-breaking utility for removing a query parameter from the current URL (supporting both regular query strings and hash-based routing) so /profile can clear the edit indicator after save/cancel.

requirements.summary: Update profile dropdown labels to reflect a single unified profile experience and keep all user-facing text in English.
acceptanceCriteria: The profile dropdown presents a single, clear navigation item for profile (label is in English).
There are no remaining English UI strings implying a separate "View Profile" vs "Edit Profile" split from the dropdown.

file_operations.description: Update dropdown item labeling to a single, unified profile entry such as "My Profile" (English only) and remove any remaining menu text that implies separate view vs edit flows (e.g., remove "View Profile"/"Edit Profile").
